answer: Reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so prior endorsements lose weight unless an identity sustains honest service over time. In the EigenTrust matrix, a freshly spawned sybil starts with negligible eigenvector centrality; reciprocal, trusted paths—not a burst of self-created accounts—are needed to propagate trust. Thus a falcon cannot pass consensus by multiplying sparrow identities or weaving a vine of collusion before earning durable, independent endorsements.
